tasks.label: One Click GitHub Upload
tasks.command: git add -A; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; git diff --cached --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 1) { git commit -m 'Auto Update'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 } } elseif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; git push; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }
